newsitem.title: USA: Rubin repeats U.S. economy on right track.
newsitem.headline: Rubin repeats U.S. economy on right track.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Wednesday repeated that he believed the U.S. economy was on a good path for growth with low inflation.
"We really are on a very good path for solid growth and low inflation," Rubin told CNN's Moneyline program.
Asked if the economy was slowing, Rubin said: "It fluctuates from month to month and quarter to quarter."

Rubin also said he believed much of the current economic strength was the result of deficit reduction efforts. Earlier on Wednesday, the Treasury Department reported a record budget surplus of $93.94 billion in April.
